description: Use when you want the names in the universe that rank highest or lowest on one metric, with optional percentile, decile and sector filters. Not for one stock's rank (use riskmodels_get_rankings). Returns, from POST /rankings/screen, the ranked rows that pass the filters; metrics, cohorts and windows are the same as for one stock's rank. End-of-day data, refreshed after each US market close. Price: $0.25 per call.

as_of.description: Ranking date (default latest), format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-06-30

cohort.description: Cohort: universe, sector or subsector, e.g. universe

decile.description: Restrict to one decile, integer 1-10, e.g. 10

metric.description: Metric: subsector_residual, sector_residual, gross_return, mkt_cap, er_l1, er_l2 or er_l3, e.g. er_l3

sector_filter.description: Restrict to one sector, by sector ETF ticker, e.g. XLK

window.description: Window in trading days: 1d, 21d, 63d or 252d, e.g. 21d

name: riskmodels_screen_rankings
title: RiskModels Rankings Screen
